_comment: The one list of in-app products. Read by scripts/gen-storekit.mjs (ios/App/GraveGoods.storekit), scripts/asc-products.mjs (App Store Connect), the build (www payments.js gets the ids and fallback prices) and docs/PLAY-PRODUCTS in store/play-listing.md. Prices are US-dollar base prices; Apple and Google convert them for other storefronts. v1 sells exactly one thing. Ad-free: the optional video slips become free claims (same caps); it gates no content.

products.reviewNote: Buy: Settings > Purchases > Ad-free. Restore: Settings > Restore purchases. The row shows only while rewarded videos are switched on.

localizations.description: No videos: claim the video bonuses free.
